name: Add Fields to Type
summary: Adds one or more fields to a custom object type (draft). One row per field: display name, API name, and data type.
whenToUse: When you're modeling a new (or existing draft) custom object type and want to give it more fields. Max 20 fields per call.

path.name: apiName
path.label: Type API name
path.hint: The type to add fields to (must be in draft state).

body.hint: One row per field. displayName = what people see; name = the API name (letters, digits, underscores); dataType = one of the allowed types (see List Field Data Types — e.g. string, integer, boolean, email, date, text).

response.description: Per field: its API name and status (created).

notes: Fields are added to the DRAFT version — remember to Approve the type afterwards for the changes to take effect.
A dedupe field (isDedupeField) is required for one-to-many relationships; most objects need one (e.g. VIN on a Car).
